description:
Found by fz-kdt.69.1 (builder finding 2, reviewer-verified). A root entry's
Activation/ActivationInputs can be minted by SeedRoot (the authoritative
producer) OR by SeedActivation reconstructing from the key's arrow (measured:
4 lib-suite cases; reconstructions agree today -- inputs=[] matches
root.input). Two producers for one owned fact is the correct-by-construction
violation; the fix is a FactKey::Activation(k)-if-root-entry -> Job::SeedRoot
producer arm. It perturbs job order (one-time deterministic re-baseline).
Doc note already placed in semantic-fixpoint.md pointing here.
title: A root entry's Activation has two producers: SeedActivation reconstructs what SeedRoot owns
